description: List every Impreza-managed VPS the customer owns (and any external bring-your-own server they registered), each with what it has LEFT — free disk, free memory, CPU load. Use to find the right `agent_id` before calling `impreza_deploy_custom`, and to pick WHICH server: a customer with two boxes usually has room on one and not the other. Returns hostname + IP + status (online/offline/draining/revoked) plus a `capacity` object per server (null when that server never reported; `stale: true` when its last heartbeat is over 15 minutes old, which means the box went quiet rather than idle).
name: impreza_list_servers
